notable_absence.finding: The page instructs readers to 'refrain from editing an exported file before importing the file back to the Couchbase cluster' but describes no import UI flow or validation step - the import half of the round-trip is asserted but not documented on this page.

cross_product_finding: This page's procedure text names 'the Couchbase Web Console > Eventing page' rather than the Capella UI used throughout every other page in this batch ('Access the Couchbase Web Console > Eventing page', 'Click on any function name to expand the UI'). This is Couchbase Server (self-managed) terminology bleeding into a page filed under cloud/eventing/, i.e. the Capella docs tree includes at least one page whose content was authored for/copied from the self-managed Server product without adaptation. Additionally, the sample exported JSON embeds a server-version-string citation in its 'version' field: "version":"evt-6.5.0-4960-ee" - this is the recurring server-version-string-citation anomaly flagged in prior rounds, appearing again here as literal example data rather than prose.
